title: Strict roots, geometric tower mate and purity result interfaces
statement: Use the coefficient-tower and section-preserving derived presentations of [def-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-interfaces, def-sp-tower-gamma-data]. For a scheme self-map g and fixed twists w and root-line coordinates r, Roots records the coefficient-unit comparison and an isomorphism g* w(1) to w(1), whose adjoint takes each scalar/root tensor to coefficient restriction tensor root restriction. orderedRoots is its ordered tensor power with the recorded shift and zero-fold unit. Q and P are inverse image on the uniformly bounded constructible finite-Tor full subcategories, with pullRealization the given equivalence counit. sourceComparison combines pullback composition, tensor, roots and shifts. exchange is proper/open exchange followed by canonical compactification refinement; mate is the adjoint mate of its inverse. purityIso is the stated tensor-orientation factorization of [det-sp-tower-gamma]. Retagging records agreement of orientation, projection-counit and tensor transpose for every presentation of the same right adjoint. Result records the domain witnesses, Roots, Retagging, invertible exchange and mate, normalized-output preservation, exact transpose, naturality of sourceComparison and the two purity-square/conjugation equations. These are the unchanged interfaces formerly declared in the geometric-mate module.

proof.text: Reuse verbatim the explicit constructions and structures of the geometric-mate interface. All choices are specified comparisons from the supplied data; no existence theorem is used to define an object.
